import fs from 'fs';

console.log('Initializing Pentest Suite...
');

const outputsDir = './outputs';
if (!fs.existsSync(outputsDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(outputsDir, { recursive: true });
  console.log('  ✓ Created outputs/ directory');
}

const readmePath = './README.md';
if (!fs.existsSync(readmePath)) {
  const content = `# Pentest Suite

Automated OWASP TOP 10 Penetration Test Tool in TypeScript/JavaScript using Playwright.

## Quick Start

\`\`\`bash
npm install && node cli/cli.js --url=https://example.com
\`\`\`

## Features

- **Reconnaissance**: DOM parsing, tech stack detection, endpoint discovery
- **Vulnerability Scanning**: OWASP TOP 10 automated tests (SQLi, XSS, Broken Auth, IDOR)
- **Exploitation Testing**: Proof-of-concept payload verification
- **Analysis & Remediation**: Findings correlation with remediation guidance
- **Report Generation**: Professional report with actionable next steps

## CLI Usage

\`\`\`bash
npm run init           # Initialize project
npm run recon          # Run reconnaissance only
npm run vuln           # Run vulnerability scan
npm run exploit        # Run exploitation tests
npm run analyze        # Analyze findings
npm run report         # Generate final report
npm run cli            # Full interactive pipeline
\`\`\`

## Architecture

- **Core**: TypeScript orchestration with Playwright automation
- **Vuln Tests**: DOM-based payload injection and detection via @playwright/test
- **CLI**: JavaScript entry points wrapping orchestrated stages

## Project Structure

\`\`\`
pentest/
├── cli/                # CLI entry points (recon, vuln, exploit, etc.)
├── src/
│   ├── core/           # Playwright orchestration (orchestrator.ts, pipeline.ts)
│   └── vuln/           # OWASP TOP 10 tests (SQLi, XSS, BrokenAuth, IDOR)
└── outputs/            # Generated reports from each stage
\`\`\`
`,
    fs.writeFileSync(readmePath, content);
  console.log('  ✓ Created README.md');
}

console.log('\n✓ Initialization complete! Run: npm install && node cli/cli.js --url=<target>');

pipeline:
  name: owasp-top10
  description: OWASP TOP 10 vulnerability testing suite
  stages:
    - name: recon
      description: Identify endpoints and sensitive data exposure
      tests:
        - name: path-traversal
          description: Check for directory traversal via ../ patterns
          vulnType: A10-Path-Traversal
          severity: critical

        - name: sqli-detection
          description: Probe for SQL injection in search/GET params
          vulnType: A01-SQLi
          severity: critical

    - name: authentication
      description: Verify weak/broken authentication mechanisms
      tests:
        - name: cookie-theft
          description: Check if session cookies are transmitted without HTTPS
          vulnType: A02-Broken-Auth
          severity: high

        - name: privilege-escalation
          description: Test IDOR vulnerability by modifying IDs in URLs
          vulnType: A05-Broken-Access
          severity: critical

        - name: csrf-test
          description: Validate CSRF protection on forms
          vulnType: A06-XSRF
          severity: high

    - name: data-exposure
      description: Identify sensitive data in responses, headers, or logs
      tests:
        - name: encryption-gap
          description: Check if PII is transmitted unencrypted via POST
          vulnType: A03-Sensitive-Data
          severity: high

    - name: xss
      description: Test reflected and persistent XSS in search/results pages
      tests:
        - name: xss-reflected
          description: Inject payload into search box and observe DOM output
          vulnType: A04-XSS
          severity: critical

        - name: xss-database
          description: Attempt to write payload into database via search form
          vulnType: A04-XSS
          severity: critical

    - name: crypto
      description: Check for weak cipher suites, hardcoded keys, or plain passwords
      tests:
        - name: insecure-crypto
          description: Probe for hardcoded encryption keys in client-side code
          vulnType: A09-Crypto-Failure
          severity: high

rules:
  - id: sql-regex
    description: Detect SQL keywords in error messages or responses
    pattern: "(UNION.*SELECT|DROP|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE)"
    vulnType: A01-SQLi
    severity: critical

  - id: xss-payload
    description: Common XSS payloads to test against
    patterns:
      - "<script>alert(1)</script>"
      - "javascript:alert(1)"
    vulnType: A04-XSS
    severity: critical

reporting:
  format: ["json", "html", "markdown"]
  outputPath: ./outputs/
  notificationWebhook: null # Slack/Teams webhook URL

arguments.content:
# Pentest Suite

Automated OWASP TOP 10 Penetration Testing Tool built with TypeScript, Playwright, and JavaScript.

## Overview

The Pentest Suite is a comprehensive web application security testing framework that automates the detection of OWASP TOP 10 vulnerabilities using modern browser automation via Playwright. It performs five stages of testing:

1. **Reconnaissance** — DOM parsing, technology stack detection, API endpoint discovery
2. **Vulnerability Scanning** — Automated OWASP TOP 10 tests (SQL injection, XSS, Broken Auth, IDOR)
3. **Exploitation Testing** — Proof-of-concept payload verification and data exfiltration attempts
4. **Analysis & Remediation** — Findings correlation with severity ratings and remediation guidance
5. **Report Generation** — Professional reports in HTML, Markdown, and JSON formats

## Quick Start

```bash
cd pentest
npm install
node cli/cli.js --url=<target>
```

### Example

```bash
node cli/cli.js --url=https://example.com
```

## Features

- ✅ **Reconnaissance**: Identifies JavaScript frameworks, API endpoints, and sensitive data exposure patterns
- ✅ **Vulnerability Scanning**: DOM-based payload testing for SQL injection, XSS, session hijacking, and IDOR
- ✅ **Exploitation Testing**: Proof-of-concept validation with data exfiltration verification
- ✅ **Analysis & Remediation**: Prioritized remediation guidance for each finding
- ✅ **Report Generation**: Professional reports in HTML, Markdown, and JSON formats

## Project Structure

```
pentest/
├── cli/                    # CLI entry points and orchestration
│   ├── cli.js              # Main pipeline orchestrator
│   ├── init.js             # Project initialization
│   ├── recon.js            # Reconnaissance stage
│   ├── vuln.js             # Vulnerability scanning
│   ├── exploit.js          # Exploitation testing
│   ├── analyze.js          # Analysis & remediation
│   └── report.js           # Report generation
├── src/
│   ├── core/
│   │   ├── orchestrator.ts # Playwright-based test orchestration
│   │   └── pipeline.ts     # Stage execution framework
│   └── vuln/               # OWASP TOP 10 vulnerability tests
│       ├── SQLi.ts         # SQL injection detection
│       ├── XSS.ts          # Cross-site scripting detection
│       ├── BrokenAuth.ts   # Session hijacking detection
│       └── BrokenAccess.ts # IDOR vulnerability detection
├── config/
│   ├── targets.yaml        # Test target configurations
│   └── test-suite.yaml     # Pipeline and rule definitions
├── outputs/                # Generated reports (created at runtime)
├── test/                   # Test runner
├── package.json            # Project manifest
└── tsconfig.json           # TypeScript configuration
```

## CLI Commands

```bash
# Full pentest pipeline
npm run cli --url=<target>

# Individual stages
npm run recon --url=<target>
npm run vuln --url=<target>
npm run exploit --url=<target>
npm run analyze --url=<target>
npm run report --url=<target>
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `PENTO_TARGET` | Default target URL for the CLI (used if no positional arg) |

## Architecture

The pentest tool follows a staged pipeline architecture:

1. **Reconnaissance**: Uses Playwright to render the target page, extract DOM information, detect JavaScript frameworks from script sources, and identify API endpoints via pattern matching.

2. **Vulnerability Scanning**: Executes DOM-based payload tests against search/input fields: SQL injection via UNION-based queries, XSS via script payload echoes, session hijacking via cookie inspection, and IDOR via URL parameter manipulation.

3. **Exploitation Testing**: Attempts data exfiltration to confirm active vulnerabilities.

4. **Analysis & Remediation**: Correlates findings with severity ratings and generates remediation advice.

5. **Report Generation**: Produces reports in multiple formats (HTML for web viewing, Markdown for documentation, JSON for CI/CD integration).

## OWASP TOP 10 Coverage

| ID | Vulnerability | Test Method |
|----|--------------|-------------|
| A01 | SQL Injection | UNION-based payload via search parameters |
| A02 | Broken Authentication | Session cookie inspection (Secure flag check) |
| A03 | Sensitive Data Exposure | POST request inspection |
| A04 | Cross-Site Scripting | Reflected XSS via input echoing |
| A05 | Broken Access Control | IDOR via URL parameter manipulation |

## License

MIT

# Pentest Suite — Usage Guide

## Overview

The Pentest Suite automates OWASP TOP 10 vulnerability testing using Playwright browser automation. It executes five stages of security testing: Reconnaissance, Vulnerability Scanning, Exploitation Testing, Analysis & Remediation, and Report Generation.

## Installation

```bash
cd pentest
npm install
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# Run full pentest pipeline
node cli/cli.js --url=<target>

# Examples
node cli/cli.js --url=https://example.com
node cli/cli.js --url=https://myapp.local

# Environment variable alternative
export PENTO_TARGET=https://myapp.local
node cli/cli.js
```

## CLI Reference

### Full Pipeline

```bash
npm run cli --url=<target>
```

Runs all five stages sequentially: Recon → Vuln Scan → Exploit → Analyze → Report.

### Individual Stages

```bash
npm run recon --url=<target>    # Reconnaissance only
npm run vuln --url=<target>     # Vulnerability scanning
npm run exploit --url=<target>  # Exploitation testing
npm run analyze --url=<target>  # Findings analysis
npm run report --url=<target>   # Report generation
```

### Help Output

```bash
node cli/cli.js --help
```

Displays available commands and examples.

## Generated Outputs

Reports are saved to `outputs/` with the following files:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `recon.txt` | DOM parsing results, tech stack detection, endpoint discovery |
| `vuln.txt` | OWASP TOP 10 vulnerability test results |
| `exploit.txt` | Proof-of-concept exploitation results |
| `analyze.txt` | Findings correlation and severity analysis |
| `report.txt` | Professional pen-test report with remediation guidance |

## Testing

```bash
cd test && node index.js
```

Runs the internal test runner to verify all CLI entry points.

## Project Structure

```
pentest/
├── cli/                    # CLI orchestrators and stage runners
│   ├── cli.js              # Main pipeline orchestration
│   ├── init.js             # Project initialization
│   ├── recon.js            # Reconnaissance execution
│   ├── vuln.js             # Vuln scan execution
│   ├── exploit.js          # Exploit test execution
│   ├── analyze.js          # Analysis execution
│   └── report.js           # Report generation
├── src/
│   ├── core/               # Playwright-based orchestration
│   │   ├── orchestrator.ts # Main test runner
│   │   └── pipeline.ts     # Stage execution framework
│   └── vuln/               # OWASP TOP 10 tests
│       ├── SQLi.ts         # SQL injection detection
│       ├── XSS.ts          # Cross-site scripting detection
│       ├── BrokenAuth.ts   # Session hijacking detection
│       └── BrokenAccess.ts # IDOR vulnerability detection
├── config/
│   ├── targets.yaml        # Target configurations
│   └── test-suite.yaml     # Pipeline rules and stages
├── docs/                   # Documentation
│   └── usage.md           # This file
└── test/                   # Test runner
```

## Security Notes

This tool tests web applications for common vulnerabilities:

- **SQL Injection**: Tests search inputs for UNION-based payload echo
- **XSS**: Tests for script payload reflection in DOM
- **Broken Authentication**: Inspects cookie Secure flag transmission
- **IDOR**: Tests URL parameter manipulation for privilege escalation

Always test against your own infrastructure first. The tool uses Playwright browser automation to render pages and execute payloads.

## License

MIT

- Initial release of Pentest Suite with full OWASP TOP 10 coverage
- Playwright-based browser automation for DOM-based vulnerability testing

- IDOR vulnerability detection via URL parameter manipulation
- Professional report generation in HTML, Markdown, and JSON formats
- CLI orchestration with stage-by-stage progress indicators
- Environment variable support (`PENTO_TARGET`) for default target URL
- TypeScript core with Playwright integration for automated DOM parsing
- Tech stack detection from JavaScript source files
- API endpoint discovery via HTML content pattern matching

### File Structure

```
pentest/
├── cli/                      # CLI entry points
│   ├── cli.js                # Main pipeline orchestration
│   ├── init.js               # Project initialization

└── CHANGELOG.md               # This file
```

### Dependencies

- `@playwright/test` — Browser automation and DOM inspection
- `chalk` — Colored terminal output for CLI stages
- `open` — Opening generated reports in browser (optional)
- `readline-sync` — Interactive prompt support (future use)
- `yaml` — Configuration parsing from YAML files

### Development Dependencies

- `typescript` — Source code compilation
- `@types/node` — TypeScript type definitions for Node.js

### Known Issues

- Playwright-based stages require browser access; headless mode may need configuration adjustment
- DOM-based payload tests rely on page content echoing; some WAFs or filtering layers may block detection
- IDOR test requires profile endpoints with numeric ID patterns

### Future Work

- Add SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) detection
- Add Command Injection testing
- Add Sensitive Data Exposure (A03) via POST inspection
- Add CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) protection testing
- Add cryptographic failure detection (weak ciphers, hardcoded keys)
- Add persistent XSS (database persistence) testing
- Add path traversal testing
